description: SFLOW semi-implicit (A 210 12, theta 0.55, SSP-RK2 predictor): steady uniform flow in a 2 km channel, slope 1e-3 (S 61), Manning n 0.03, q 2 m2/s in (B 60 1), the normal depth 1.4686 m out (F 50 2): C1 of the SFLOW / TELEMAC-2D / HEC-RAS 2D benchmark. On f74df90aa a standing oscillation of +-0.1 m stayed in the lower half (the lagged acceleration of the implicit part and the extrapolated advecting discharge of the stages); now steady within 1 mm of the normal depth.
covers: discharge inflow as flux boundary, water level outflow as Dirichlet boundary
